class: Posting navigation classified as final submission by label alone
symptom: The page agent identified a job description and chose Apply, but the browser guard denied the click and handed off before the application opened. Both saved pages were inspected: a privacy dialog followed by the job listing.
root_cause: The browser guard treated Apply as a final-submission synonym without the posting context already recognized by the page agent. Live ADP DOM showed a form-free sdf-button inside the job-detail apply row.
why_tests_missed: Submission tests covered final controls and credentials but omitted ADP's posting-entry custom element.
fix: Add an ADP-specific click-time posting-entry predicate under sites/adp.py. Require the exact ADP host, job-detail route and requisition, expected component and Apply label, no form association, and no visible form, dialog or input controls. Other submission checks remain unchanged.
prevention: Distinguish proven application entry from final submission using portal structure and live state, while keeping ambiguous Apply controls denied.
